card.name: The word one in one-at-a-time
card.fires_on: The word "one" right before "at a time", "by one" or "after the next", where things are handled singly in sequence. It follows a noun or verb phrase describing the items.

modes.label: One at a time
modes.description: "one" begins a phrase meaning items handled singly in turn.
modes.example: lift your legs over the side of the tub<< one>> at a time

modes.label: One by one / after the next
modes.description: "one" in a sequence phrase for stepwise processing of items.
modes.example: I'm wading through Patrick O'Brian's Aubrey/Maturin novels<< one>> by one

card.writes: It promotes words about going through items one by one, such as looping, iterating and "one by one" in Chinese.
card.plain: It marks the spot where text says things are done singly, one after another.
